verdict.rationale: Linear documents a deprecation policy: @deprecated schema annotations, proactive outreach with "plenty of time" before breaking changes, and [API]-prefixed changelog entries. Its own docs state the GraphQL API "doesn't have versioning like many REST APIs," so only half of the story is delivered. The published, introspectable schema helps users track changes but is not a substitute for versions. Missing for 10: versioned API endpoints or schema versions, a concrete deprecation timeline or sunset window, independent corroboration that the policy is followed in practice.
